intro: One playthrough is enough for all 55 trophies — there are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. The run is long, not hard: launch-era guides put it at around 200 hours. Work the stages in order, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never use cheats on your trophy save (cheats switch trophies and saving off). Each stage below shows its trophies, its timing, and what to have ready before you start it.

stages.body: Turn cheats off and leave them off. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and no mission replay or New Game Plus — keep one save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony): it is the one thing that can be missed. Before the first mission, decide your save discipline: one slot per chapter start, one slot before the final mission, and the rest as rolling backups. That discipline is the whole safety net for the list.
stages.tip: Make the Chapter 1 save before Gone Fishing, not after — the meditation window opens early in the chapter.
stages.title: Before you start

stages.body: Play the story straight through. All 12 chapter and named-mission trophies pop as you go, and the final mission pays the gold. Do the Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon, time-sensitive, counts toward Strangers & Freaks), and take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock bank-vault robberies. While the story runs, build the passive totals: scan traffic with WAiNK, tag locations, grab cards on your route, and try each activity once as it unlocks. The story is also where the two golds are decided — the final mission and 100% completion — so a clean story run is the fastest road to the Platinum.
stages.tip: Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — it is your only way back to the ending.
stages.title: The story — Chapters 1 to 4
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.body: Finish the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each end in a finale trophy, and 8 other stranger strands make Strangers & Freaks. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks because they have their own trophies — check the counter after each strand you finish, since the counter is the only reliable record of which ones counted. All side-story finales stay open after the credits, so do them in a batch: the travel is shorter when you sweep them in one run than when you chase them one at a time between story missions.
stages.tip: Batch the finales after the story — they stay open, and one sweep beats six separate trips.
stages.title: Side stories

stages.body: The one-off feats, most of them quick: steal a jet from a VCIA boarding bridge, climb into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, rob a jewelry store unseen with the Snap Gun, rob three shops in a row with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, and take down five enemies in one Combat Focus. Partner trophies need Jason and Lucia together, which opens in Chapter 2. Do these in the order the guides suggest, not the order they appear on the list: the vault run (Maximum Withdrawal) also pays Hot Together, and the illegal operations (Pest Control) are the best venue for Gunslinger. One vault run can advance three trophies at once.
stages.tip: Pair the feats: a vault run pays Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together, and operations pay Pest Control and Gunslinger.
stages.title: Free-roam firsts

stages.body: Meditate at every spot (do the Chapter 1 balcony one first — it is missable), finish three card sets, WAiNK 100 locations, scan 100 vehicles, buy all eight garages, register ten cars with Scooter Bros, and explore all of Leonida. Fold all of these into normal travel so the cleanup is short: a card on your route is free, a card you drive across the map for is expensive, and the same is true of every item in this stage. Buy garages as you can afford them — they give you the free spaces On the Spot needs — and register cheap cars, since the trophy counts registrations, not value.
stages.tip: Fold collectibles into travel from Chapter 2 — a cleanup run at the end is the slowest way to do this stage.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration
stages.when: Throughout, cleaned up after the story

stages.body: The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 42 shooting-range golds, a drone win at all 14 locations, 20 race wins and $250,000 of laundered marked bills. Most of it is already half done if you played the earlier stages properly — open the 100% page in this guide, tick off what is finished, and work the shortest remaining items first. The two riddle trophies (Bad Luck, I Guess and The Truth Is Out There) have no confirmed method yet: finish everything else first, then check their cards for updates. When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows.
stages.tip: Work the shortest remaining 100% items first — the last few are usually a handful of stunts and one vault.
stages.title: The long grind and the Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
